Luminous.description: Radiating an inner glow that can illuminate dark spaces or blind attackers.

features.name: Luminous Sprite
features.tldr: You can shed bright light from your body and use flashes of light to dazzle foes.

Grig.description: Ressembling cricket-like fey with incredible leaping power and musical talent.

features.name: Grig Sprite
